name: search_proposals
description: Search the local RFFF proposal-assessment catalog by structured filters and/or free-text keywords. Returns proposal-level rows only — no personnel detail — plus result meta. Cheap discovery: use it to find proposals matching criteria when no proposal_number is known yet. Do NOT use it when you need personnel, factor assessments, or files for one known proposal (call get_proposal), and do NOT use it just to count things (call aggregate_assessments). keywords matches proposal titles and submitting-entity names, case-insensitive. All filters are exact matches against observed values; the four factor filters and person_overall_assessment are person-level — a proposal matches when at least one of its personnel matches. person_overall_assessment is an opaque stored value: filter and report it verbatim only, never compute, derive, or explain it.

keywords.description: Free-text search over proposal titles and submitting-entity names (case-insensitive substring match).

limit.description: Maximum rows to return; the server additionally caps every response at MCP_MAX_ROWS.

filters.description: Optional exact-match filters, ANDed together. Every field is enum-ish: the allowed values are the OBSERVED value sets profiled from rfff_seed (x-enum-source: observed_enums), regenerated on every seed run and rendered into this description at runtime by the MCP server — deliberately not enumerated in this frozen structural contract.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year of the proposal. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

reviewing_component.description: Reviewing component. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

reviewing_subcomponent.description: Reviewing subcomponent. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

assessment_state.description: Assessment state. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

mitigation_status.description: Mitigation status on the proposal. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

award_state.description: Award state. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

award_type.description: Award type. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

review_type.description: Assessment/review type. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

factor1_assessment.description: Factor 1 (FTRP) person-level assessment; matches proposals with at least one matching person. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

factor2_assessment.description: Factor 2 (Funding) person-level assessment; matches proposals with at least one matching person. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

factor3_assessment.description: Factor 3 (Patents) person-level assessment; matches proposals with at least one matching person. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

factor4_assessment.description: Factor 4 (Entity Lists) person-level assessment; matches proposals with at least one matching person. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

person_overall_assessment.description: Opaque overall personnel assessment (person-level; at least one matching person). Exact match only — never computed or explained. Observed values, regenerated at seed time.

data.description: Matching proposal rows (proposal-level fields only; no personnel).

total.description: Total matches before the row cap.

truncated.description: True when rows or long text fields were truncated.
